name: How long do typical home repairs take to schedule and finish?

mainEntity.name: How long do typical home repairs take to schedule and finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the repair, but urgent issues like active leaks, electrical problems, or water intrusion should be addressed as soon as possible. Minor fixes may take a short visit, while more involved repairs can take longer if materials must be ordered or hidden damage is found.
acceptedAnswer.description: Emergency issues should be handled right away. Simple fixes may be quick, but larger repairs can take longer if parts, permits, or hidden damage are involved.
